_note: Identifier-shaped values this repository legitimately contains.
1234567 / 5082392 / 3081375 are the examples UK Biobank publish in their own
tool's regex documentation, reproduced here so the pattern can be explained and
asserted against. 1234568 and 1234569 are synthetic test fixtures. 1094933 and
6500000 is the range-boundary test value; 5654321 a notebook test fixture.
1870254 are a Stack Overflow answer URL used to illustrate a false-positive guard.
This is an allowlist of exact literals, not a way to skip files: a real
identifier appearing anywhere in this repository must still be reported.
